root_causes.root_cause: RFC-028 D2 added a presentation-forms garble check in _is_garbled_blob (helpers.py:880-895) that fires when >50% of Arabic characters are in the Presentation Forms ranges (U+FB50-FDFF, U+FE70-FEFF). The Human Rights document text layer uses Arabic Presentation Forms characters (confirmed by filename analysis: 6/10 Arabic chars are PF). RFC-028 explicitly references this document (D2 trace: Finding #7 huquq al-insan). validate_tree rejects the tree with reason=garbling (helpers.py:1142-1143). The OCR retry path (client.py:991-1082) runs force_full_page_ocr but either fails or produces fewer chars than the original, so the D4 best-of-two comparison (client.py:1062-1081) restores the original garbled result. reason=garbling is explicitly excluded from flat routing (FLAT-03-C2, client.py:1286), so LowQualityTreeError is raised (client.py:1538). The worker maps this to terminal reason=low_quality_tree (worker.py:431-441), no artifacts are saved, and no flat fallback is attempted.
root_causes.code_path: helpers.py:_is_garbled_blob (D2 PF check) -> helpers.py:validate_tree -> client.py:index (garbling recovery) -> client.py:raise LowQualityTreeError -> converters_cli -> worker.py:_TERMINAL_CHILD_REASONS
root_causes.suggested_fix: Two options: (A) Add a presentation-forms-to-logical-order Unicode normalization step in _pre_inference_normalize (converters.py) that maps U+FE70-FEFF and U+FB50-FDFF characters to their canonical decomposition equivalents via unicodedata.normalize('NFKC'), so the text passes the garble check and tree validation. (B) Add garbling as a flat-routing-eligible reason after all recovery paths exhaust (preserving content even if garbled, since the previous 328-node/498k-char artifact was usable). Option A is preferred as it treats the root cause (wrong encoding) rather than the symptom.
